**To delete an asset model**

The following ``delete-asset-model`` example deletes a wind turbine asset model. ::

    aws iotsitewise delete-asset-model \
        --asset-model-id a1b2c3d4-5678-90ab-cdef-11111EXAMPLE

Output::

    {
        "assetModelStatus": {
            "state": "DELETING"
        }
    }
